shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- metadata ---\\n' && cat components/request-metadata.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json && rg -n 'instant\\s*=\\s*false|force-dynamic|force-static|fetchCache|export const revalidate|experimental_ppr' app components next.config.ts || true"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFileSync } from \"node:fs\"; const html = readFileSync(\".next/server/app/index.html\", \"utf8\"); for (const text of [\"<nav>Operations</nav>\", \"Deployment health\", \"All systems operational\", \"Loading request details…\"]) console.log("'`${text}: ${html.includes(text)}`); console.log(`request metadata in shell: ${/Request [0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27,}/i.test(html)}`)'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'const responses = []; for (let i=0;i<2;i++) { const r = await fetch(\"http://127.0.0.1:3210/\", {cache:\"no-store\"}); const body = await r.text(); const match = body.match(/Request (?:<"'!-- -->)?([0-9a-f-]{36})(?:<!-- -->)? generated at (?:<!-- -->)?([''^<]+)(?:<!-- -->)? '"\\(sample (?:<"'!-- -->)?([0-9.]+)/i); responses.push({status:r.status, match:match?.slice(1), navigation:body.includes("<nav>Operations</nav>")}); await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,30)); } console.log(JSON.stringify(responses,null,2)); if (responses.some(r=>r.status!==200 || !r.match || !r.navigation) || responses[0].match.some((value,i)=>value===responses[1].match[i])) process.exit(1)'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git ls-files && cat next-env.d.ts && git diff -- package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFileSync } from \"node:fs\"; const html = readFileSync(\".next/server/app/_not-found.html\", \"utf8\"); for (const text of [\"<nav>Operations</nav>\", \"Loading request details…\"]) console.log("'`${text}: ${html.includes(text)}`)'"'"
